pages.text: The disk drive moves programs between c0de disks and your computer.

Right-click it and put a disk into its slot. $(l)Save$() writes the program of the disk into the folder $(1)c0de$() of your Minecraft (next to $(1)saves$() and $(1)screenshots$()). $(l)Load$() lists the programs in that folder; click one to put it onto the disk. Other players can load the files you give them.
Iron ingots in the top and bottom rows, and two smooth stone slabs with redstone dust between them in the middle row.

Save the program of a disk on your computer. Send the file $(1)c0de/doorbell.yaml$() to a friend. They put it into their own $(1)c0de$() folder, load it onto a disk with their drive and build it on an empty sheet.
